title: Olleik Foods: admin guide
pronunciation: "Olleik" is written "Oh-lake" in the spoken text only; on screen it stays "Olleik"

lines.text: Welcome. This guide walks you through the Olleik Foods admin, one task at a time.
lines.speak: Welcome. This guide walks you through the Oh-lake Foods admin, one task at a time.
lines.caption: Welcome to the Olleik Foods admin guide

lines.text: Sign in to the admin with your email. Only the emails on the admin list have access.
lines.caption: Only emails on the admin list can sign in

lines.text: The dashboard is your starting point. New orders show first.
lines.caption: New orders show first on the dashboard

lines.text: Choose Orders in the sidebar to see every order.
lines.caption: Choose Orders in the sidebar

lines.text: The New tab lists the orders waiting for you. Open one to see it in full.
lines.caption: The New tab: orders waiting for you

lines.text: Check the items, the profit on each line and the customer's note.
lines.caption: Items, profit per line and the customer's note

lines.text: Choose Confirm. The stock is deducted and the order shows as confirmed.
lines.caption: Confirm: the stock is deducted

lines.text: When it's packed, mark it Prepared. Then mark it Complete.
lines.caption: Mark it Prepared, then Complete

lines.text: Every order has an invoice.
lines.caption: Every order has an invoice

lines.text: It carries your business details, the customer's details and every line. Print it, or save it as a PDF.
lines.caption: Your details, the customer's, every line

lines.text: New applications arrive in Leads. Review one, then set its status to Approved.
lines.caption: Applications arrive in Leads: set Approved

lines.text: To add the customer, pick the approved lead and convert it.
lines.caption: Convert the approved lead into a customer

lines.text: The new customer joins your list, with their status and payment terms.
lines.caption: Every customer, with status and terms

lines.text: Open the customer to invite them to the portal. Send email delivers the invite.
lines.caption: Send email delivers the portal invite

lines.text: No email? Copy the invite link and share it yourself.
lines.caption: No email? Copy the invite link

lines.text: Catalog visibility controls which products this customer can see.
lines.caption: Choose which products they can see

lines.text: Each customer has their own price on every product assigned to them.
lines.caption: Each customer has their own prices

lines.text: Products lists the stock, the cost and the sale price of every item.
lines.caption: Stock, cost and price in one list

lines.text: Choose Add product, then enter the code, the name and the pack size.
lines.caption: Add product: code, name and pack size

lines.text: Enter the cost and the price. Your cost stays private: customers only see the price.
lines.caption: Cost stays private; customers see the price

lines.text: Create the product. It appears in the list, ready to assign.
lines.caption: Created: in the list, ready to assign

lines.text: Categories keep the catalog organised.
lines.caption: Categories keep the catalog organised

lines.text: Assign products chooses which customers can order each item.
lines.caption: Choose which customers can order each item

lines.text: Pricing sets a default margin for the whole catalog.
lines.caption: A default margin for the whole catalog

lines.text: A margin for a product, a category or a customer overrides the default.
lines.caption: Product, category or customer margins override it

lines.text: Analytics shows your revenue over the period you choose.
lines.caption: Revenue over the period you choose

lines.text: Below the chart, each product's units, revenue and profit.
lines.caption: Units, revenue and profit per product

lines.text: Reports builds a printable summary. Pick a preset, or tick the sections you need.
lines.caption: Build a report from presets or sections

lines.text: Every document prints with your business details at the top.
lines.caption: Your business details on every document

lines.text: A customer statement lists their products and orders for the period you pick.
lines.caption: A customer statement for any period

lines.text: The product list shows the whole catalog, with stock and prices.
lines.caption: The product list: catalog, stock and prices

lines.text: Low stock lists the items to reorder, each with what's left.
lines.caption: Low stock: what to reorder

lines.text: Unavailable products lists anything customers can't order right now.
lines.caption: Unavailable products, when there are any

lines.text: That's the admin tour. Every document has a Print button when you need paper.
lines.caption: Every document has a Print button
